Bamboo Baby Feeding Bowl Set – Natural Fiber Eco-Friendly Tableware

The Fibberr Bamboo Baby Feeding Bowl Set offers eco-conscious parents a practical feeding solution made from 100% natural bamboo fiber. This lightweight tableware set includes a feeding bowl, plate, and matching utensils designed specifically for infants, toddlers, and young children.

Smart Design Features

Constructed from eco-friendly bamboo fiber, this tableware set is lightweight, durable, and biodegradable. The smooth, rounded edges are designed for little hands and safe self-feeding, while the naturally antibacterial surface maintains hygienic feeding conditions. The stain- and odor-resistant material ensures lasting freshness through daily use.

The vibrant, creative designs encourage positive eating habits, making mealtime more engaging for kids. The portable build makes it ideal for meals at home or on the go, and the dishwasher-safe construction allows for easy cleanup after each use.

Setup and Usage

Use the bowl and plate for baby's meals, pairing them with the included toddler-safe utensils. Clean after each use with mild soap and water or place in the dishwasher. Avoid using in the microwave to maintain material integrity.

Product Specifications

Material: 100% natural bamboo fiber
Style: Lightweight and portable infant tableware set
Colors: Various cute and creative designs
Suitable for: Infants, toddlers, and young children
Package: 1 feeding bowl, 1 plate, and matching utensils

Why Choose This Tableware

Sustainable bamboo fiber materials protect your child and the planet. The durable design withstands daily use and drops, while the naturally antibacterial surface ensures hygienic feeding. Cute patterns make mealtime engaging for kids, and the lightweight build makes it ideal for travel and outdoor use.

products.body_html:
Bamboo Baby Tableware Set – Complete Non-Slip Feeding Solution

The Tadduri Bamboo Baby Tableware Set provides everything needed for safe, independent feeding. Crafted from natural bamboo wood with BPA-free silicone bases, this 6-piece set combines stability, durability, and eco-friendly materials for stress-free mealtimes.

Key Features

  • Non-Slip Silicone Base: Prevents dishes from sliding or tipping during meals
  • Natural Bamboo Construction: Chemical-free, sustainable material safe for babies
  • Complete 6-Piece Set: Bowl, dinner plate, cup, bib, spoon, and fork included
  • BPA-Free Materials: Food-grade silicone and bamboo for complete safety
  • Ergonomic Utensils: Designed for small hands learning to self-feed
  • Heat-Resistant: Withstands warm foods and easy cleaning

How to Use

Place the non-slip base on any clean, flat surface before serving food. The silicone base creates a secure grip that prevents spills and messes. The easy-grip utensils allow toddlers to practice self-feeding with confidence. Clean each piece with warm, soapy water after use to maintain the bamboo's natural finish.

Product Specifications

Material: Natural bamboo wood with BPA-free silicone
Design: Complete mealtime set with non-slip base
Colors: Neutral Wood with Pastel Silicone Accents
Suitable for: Babies and toddlers during feeding and training
Package: 1 bowl, 1 plate, 1 cup, 1 bib, 1 fork, 1 spoon

Why Choose This Bamboo Feeding Set

Eco-conscious parents choose bamboo for its sustainability and natural antibacterial properties. The non-slip base eliminates frustration during mealtimes, while the complete set provides everything needed from first foods through toddler years. Durable bamboo construction ensures long-lasting use without chemicals or plastics. Makes an ideal baby shower gift or addition to any nursery.
